articles.title: The Republic
articles.content: Bangladesh is a unitary, independent, sovereign Republic to be known as the People's Republic of Bangladesh.

articles.title: The State territory
articles.content: The territory of the Republic shall comprise the territories which immediately before the proclamation of independence constituted East Pakistan, and such other territories as may become included in Bangladesh.

articles.title: The State religion
articles.content: The state religion of the Republic is Islam, but the State shall ensure equal status and equal right in the practice of the Hindu, Buddhist, Christian and other religions.

articles.title: The State language
articles.content: The state language of the Republic is Bangla.

articles.title: National anthem, flag and emblem
articles.content: The national anthem is the first ten lines of 'Amar Sonar Bangla'. The national flag consists of a red circle on a green bottle field. The national emblem is the national flower Shapla (Nymphaea nouchali) resting on water, flanked by two sheaves of paddy, crested by three connected leaves of jute with two stars on each side.

articles.title: The Capital
articles.content: The capital of the Republic is Dhaka.

articles.title: Citizenship
articles.content: The citizenship of Bangladesh shall be determined and regulated by law. The people of Bangladesh shall be known as Bangalees as a nation and the citizens of Bangladesh shall be known as Bangladeshis.

articles.title: Supremacy of the Constitution
articles.content: All powers in the Republic belong to the people, and their exercise on behalf of the people shall be effected only under, and by the authority of, this Constitution. This Constitution is the supreme law of the Republic.
